recurring_donation_membership_relationsh.description:
Associates an existing membership with the recurring donation. Only the link is written:
the membership, other recurring donations and donations are not changed. Create or update
the membership with `/api/v2/memberships`.

Send the membership `id` and no `included` entry; `method` is optional and, when sent, must
be `update`. Membership attributes, `method: create`, `method: destroy` and `method: disassociate` return 400. A
membership you cannot see returns 404.

Returns 422, and writes nothing, when the membership belongs to another signup, when the
recurring donation already has a different membership, when another active, failing or
pending recurring donation pays for the membership, or when a donation on the recurring
donation belongs to another membership.

info.description:
The NationBuilder V2 API is a JSON:API-compliant API for managing NationBuilder
resources such as people, donations, events, and lists. It layers a few
conventions on top of the JSON:API standard, described below. For a broader
introduction, see the
[NationBuilder v2 API core concepts](https://support.nationbuilder.com/en/articles/9757369-nationbuilder-v2-api-core-concepts)
guide.

### Request and response format

Requests and responses follow the [JSON:API](https://jsonapi.org/) document
structure: single resources are returned under a top-level `data` member, and
collections are paginated arrays of resource objects with `links` for the
current, previous, and next pages. Related resources can be sideloaded into a
top-level `included` array with the `include` query parameter, and responses
can be trimmed to specific attributes with `fields[resource_type]` sparse
fieldsets (plus opt-in `extra_fields[resource_type]` attributes where noted).
Responses are served as `application/vnd.api+json`; request bodies may be
sent as `application/vnd.api+json` or `application/json`.

Filtering uses an operator syntax: `filter[attribute]=value` for
equality (comma-separated values act as OR), and
`filter[attribute][operator]=value` for other comparisons. String attributes
support `eq`, `not_eq`, `eql`, `not_eql`, `prefix`, `not_prefix`, `suffix`,
`not_suffix`, `match`, and `not_match`; numeric and date attributes support
`eq`, `not_eq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, and `lte`. Note that JSON:API relationship
routes (`/resource/{id}/relationships/other`) are not provided; related
resources are reachable through the filtered index URLs given in each
resource's `relationships` links.

### Errors

Error responses use a flat JSON body with a machine-readable `code` and a
human-readable `message`. Some errors carry additional detail members (for
example `validation_errors`). The exception is 422 validation failures,
which return a JSON:API `errors` array locating each invalid field via
`source.pointer`.

### Rate limiting

Requests are limited per access token (250 requests per 10-second window).
Every response includes `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, and
`RateLimit-Reset` headers; exceeding the limit returns a 429 with a
`Retry-After` header.

get.description:
Lists recurring donations. A recurring donation is *managed* when NationBuilder bills it and
*unmanaged* when an external processor bills it and NationBuilder only records it.
Use `filter[managed]=false` to list unmanaged recurring donations.

200.description: A page of matching recurring donations.

get.summary: List all recurring donations in a nation

post.description:
Records an unmanaged recurring donation: an external processor bills the donor and
NationBuilder only records the series.

`signup_id`, `amount_in_cents`, `frequency` and `start_date` are required. `payment_type` is
always `donation`. `merchant_account_id` is read-only, so every recurring donation created
here is unmanaged.

**Membership** — to record which membership the series pays for, send the membership as a
relationship. See `recurring_donation_membership_relationship`.

400.description:
The request could not have been meant. A missing `frequency` or `start_date`, an unknown
`frequency`, a read-only attribute such as `merchant_account_id`, a status a client
may not set, or a membership relationship that is not a plain `method: update`.

422.description:
The request is well formed but the recurring donation is not. A missing `signup_id` or
`amount_in_cents`, an amount of zero or less, cadence and duplicate `external_id` failures
land here as a validation error document. A membership
that cannot be associated lands here as an error response, and no recurring donation is
created.

delete.description:
Deletes a recurring donation and writes a `Recurring Donation Deleted` activity. The link to
a membership goes with it; the membership itself is untouched.

A recurring donation with donations attached cannot be deleted, because nothing would clean
up those donations. Unlink or delete them first.

200.description: Confirmation that the recurring donation was deleted.

400.description: The recurring donation has donations attached.

delete.summary: Delete recurring donation with provided ID

get.description: Returns the recurring donation that matches the given ID.
get.summary: Show recurring donation with provided ID

patch.description:
Updates a recurring donation. Which fields you may send depends on who bills it.

**Unmanaged** — the non-billing fields plus `amount_in_cents` and `status`.

**Managed** — the non-billing fields only. Sending `amount_in_cents` or `status` returns
400, because NationBuilder bills the donor and the gateway owns them.

`signup_id` and `frequency` are create-only. `merchant_account_id` is read-only. `canceled`
is not a `status` you can send; cancel with
`PATCH /api/v2/recurring_donations/{id}/cancel`.

A membership relationship associates a membership with a recurring donation that has none.
Sending the membership it already has changes nothing. See
`recurring_donation_membership_relationship`.

400.description:
A field this kind of recurring donation may not change, a create-only field, a status
a client may not set, `start_date` or `external_id` set to null, or a membership
relationship that is not a plain `method: update`.

422.description:
The recurring donation failed validation, such as a duplicate `external_id`, as a
validation error document. A membership that cannot be associated lands here as an
error response.

patch.summary: Update recurring donation with provided ID

patch.description:
Cancels a recurring donation NationBuilder does not bill. Recurring donations NationBuilder
bills are canceled in the control panel or the supporter portal, and return 400 here.

The recurring donation is always canceled immediately: its status becomes `canceled`,
`canceled_date` is set, and a `Recurring Donation Canceled` activity is written. What
happens to the membership it pays for depends on the body.

**`data.canceled_date`** — stamps that date on the recurring donation and its activity
instead of now. Send this to import a series that already ended. It only changes the
recorded date: the membership is still canceled now unless `data.membership_expires_on`
is sent.

**No `data.membership_expires_on`** — the membership is canceled now as well.

**`data.membership_expires_on`** — the membership stays active until that date, with a
`Membership Cancelation Scheduled` activity attributed to the token owner. The nightly
membership job cancels it on that date. Send this to honour the period the donor already
paid for. There is no default; the recurring donation's `next_bill_date` is not used as
one.

400.description:
Returned when any of these is true:

* The body is not wrapped in `data`.
* `data` carries a key other than `membership_expires_on` or `canceled_date`.
* NationBuilder bills this recurring donation.
* `data.membership_expires_on` was sent for a recurring donation that pays for no membership.
* `data.membership_expires_on` is not an ISO 8601 date.
* `data.canceled_date` is not an ISO 8601 date or date-time.

422.description:
Returned when any of these is true:

* The recurring donation is already canceled.
* The membership is no longer active.
* `data.membership_expires_on` was sent and another active, failing or pending recurring
  donation pays for the membership.
* `data.membership_expires_on` is in the past.
* `data.canceled_date` is in the future.
* `data.canceled_date` is before the recurring donation's `start_date`.
* `data.canceled_date` is before the recurring donation's last successful payment.

**Required attributes:**
- `site_id` - ID of the site to create the page on

- `slug` - URL-friendly identifier -- `https://yoursite.com/slug` (auto-generated from name if not provided)

tags.description:
Suggestion boxes are containers for collecting suggestions from your community. They
live on website pages, and define the settings, auto-responses, categorization tags,
and moderation rules for suggestions.

**Relationship:** Suggestions are created as child pages of SuggestionBoxes.
tags.name: Suggestion Boxes

tags.description:
Suggestions are individual ideas or proposals submitted to suggestion boxes on your site.
They can be responded to, categorized, and managed by administrators.

**Responding to Suggestions:**
Responses consist of optional text `official_response` and/or status via `response_type_id`. You can provide just text, just status, or both combined to officially respond to a suggestion.

**Response Options:**
- `official_response` - Text response (optional)
- `response_type_id` - Status update (optional)
- `response_author_id` - Signup ID of person that provided the response (optional)
- `responded_at` - When the response was provided (optional)

**Response Type IDs:
- `0` - Not Planned
- `1` - Considering
- `2` - Planned
- `3` - Started
- `4` - Completed
- `5` - Incomplete
- `6` - Duplicate
- `7` - Submitted (default)
tags.name: Suggestions
